'''Refour''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Refour appears in the mission "Usurper" for Republic classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
